content: Configuration of <User_TxConfirmation>() : The upper layer module, which provides this callback service, has to be configured by CanI- fTxPduUserTxConfirmationUL . If no upper layer modules are configured for trans- mit confirmation using <User_TxConfirmation>() , no transmit confirmation is ex- ecuted.
